ValidationRule.description: "Subscriber To LMO" Feature Parameter Values cannot be manually created or updated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(AND( ISPICKVAL( sfFma__FeatureParameter__r.sfFma__DataFlowDirection__c , "Subscriber To LMO") , $User.Id <> sfFma__FeatureParameter__r.CreatedById ), ISCHANGED( sfFma__Value__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Subscriber To LMO feature parameter values can only be created or updated by the Feature Management app. Click undo or cancel to continue.
